meta.name: azure-quotas
meta.description: Check/manage Azure quotas and usage across providers. For deployment planning, capacity validation, region selection. WHEN: "check quotas", "service limits", "current usage", "request quota increase", "quota exceeded", "validate capacity", "regional availability", "provisioning limits", "vCPU limit", "how many vCPUs available in my subscription".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 检查和管理 Azure 配额与使用量
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要管理 Azure 配额确保资源可用
copy.tagline_en: Check and manage Azure quotas and usage
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to manage Azure quotas to ensure resource availability

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会通过 Azure CLI 帮你查询 Azure 各项配额（服务限制）的当前用量和剩余容量，还能对比不同区域、提交配额提升请求。
howto.when: 当你说“check quotas”“quota exceeded”等关键词，或要求验证容量、对比区域、申请配额提升时触发。

say.text: 查一下当前订阅在 eastus 的 vCPU 配额和用量。
say.note: 会返回限制值、已用量和剩余量。

say.text: 比较 eastus 和 westus2 的 vCPU 配额余量。
say.note: 会列出两个区域的配额对比。

say.text: 帮我把 eastus 的 vCPU 配额提升到 500。
say.note: 会调用命令提交提升请求。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude uses Azure CLI to query Azure quotas, current usage, and available capacity, compare regions, and submit quota increase requests.
howto.when_en: When you mention keywords like "check quotas", "quota exceeded", or ask to validate capacity, compare regions, or request quota increases.

say_en.text: Check the vCPU quota and usage for eastus in my subscription.
say_en.note: Returns limit, usage, and available amount.

say_en.text: Compare vCPU quota availability between eastus and westus2.
say_en.note: Shows quota comparison for both regions.

say_en.text: Increase my eastus vCPU quota to 500.
